body.zh-Hant: 1921年，哥倫比亞參議院的歷史頁記載，因「Urrutia Thompson」與巴拿馬運河有關的事件，時任總統馬可·菲德爾·蘇亞雷斯受到指控。他請求在全體會議上發言為自己辯護後，失去保守黨人的支持；他離開職位，由豪爾赫·奧爾金接任。
body.en: The Colombian Senate’s history page records that in 1921, over the “Urrutia Thompson” matter concerning the Panama Canal, President Marco Fidel Suárez was accused. After asking to be allowed to speak in the plenary to defend himself, he lost the support of the Conservatives; he withdrew from office and was succeeded by Jorge Holguín.

Se retira del cargo y lo sucede Jorge Holguín

body.zh-Hant: 德意志國家圖書館的GND人名權威檔記載，馬可·菲德爾·蘇亞雷斯生於1855年4月23日，出生地為貝略（Bello）；他於1927年4月3日在波哥大去世。該權威檔把他歸為哥倫比亞的政治人物，並註明他曾任哥倫比亞總統。
body.en: The GND name authority file of the German National Library records that Marco Fidel Suárez was born on 23 April 1855 in Bello and died in Bogotá on 3 April 1927. It classes him as a Colombian politician and notes that he was President of Colombia.

body.zh-Hant: 卡爾利斯·烏爾馬尼斯1877年9月4日生於多貝萊縣烏澤教區的皮克沙農場。1896年他離開耶爾加瓦非古典中學，前往東普魯士的蒂拉皮亞乳牛場學校求學。1902至1903年在蘇黎世聯邦理工學院就讀。1905年12月21日，他因參與1905年革命被捕，囚於普斯科夫；1906年獲釋，1907年移居美國紐約。1913年3月俄國宣布革命者大赦後，他返回拉脫維亞。
body.en: Kārlis Ulmanis was born on 4 September 1877 at the Pikšas farmstead, Udze parish, Dobele district. In 1896 he left the Jelgava Non-classical Secondary School for a dairy farm school at Tapiava in East Prussia. He studied at the Federal Polytechnic School of Zurich in 1902–1903. Arrested on 21 December 1905 for taking part in the 1905 revolution and jailed in Pskov, he was released in 1906 and moved to New York in 1907. After the March 1913 amnesty for the revolutionaries of 1905 he returned to Latvia.

heading.zh-Hant: 農業工作與早期政治活動
heading.en: Agricultural work and early political activity

body.zh-Hant: 1914至1916年間，烏爾馬尼斯在波羅的海農民協會工作，並編輯該會的雜誌《Zeme》。1916年他當選波羅的海拉脫維亞難民援助委員會成員。1917年3月，他當選維澤梅臨時土地委員會成員，4月出任維澤梅省臨時副專員，並參與創立拉脫維亞農民聯盟。1918年11月17日，他被選為拉脫維亞人民委員會的總理。
body.en: From 1914 to 1916 Ulmanis worked for the Baltic Farmers’ Association and edited its magazine Zeme. In 1916 he was elected to the board of the committee supporting Baltic Latvian refugees. In March 1917 he was elected to the Vidzeme Temporary Land Council, in April became interim Deputy Commissioner of Vidzeme province, and took part in founding the Latvian Farmers Union. On 17 November 1918 he was elected Prime Minister of the Latvian People’s Council.

heading.zh-Hant: 臨時政府時期的政府首腦與部長
heading.en: Prime Minister and minister under the provisional government

body.zh-Hant: 1918年11月18日，拉脫維亞人民委員會委託他組閣；他在11月18日至12月19日出任農業部長，並自11月19日起出任總理，至1919年7月13日。1919年1月，由他領導的臨時政府有一部分流亡海外。他於1919年7月14日至9月4日再任農業部長，並於7月14日至12月8日再任總理。1919年10月16日至1920年6月11日他擔任國防部長，1919年12月9日至1920年6月11日同時擔任總理與安全部長。
body.en: On 18 November 1918 the Latvian People’s Council entrusted him with forming a government. He was Minister of Agriculture from 18 November to 19 December and Prime Minister from 19 November 1918 to 13 July 1919. In January 1919 part of the provisional government he headed emigrated. He was again Minister of Agriculture from 14 July to 4 September 1919 and Prime Minister from 14 July to 8 December 1919. He was Minister of Defence from 16 October 1919 to 11 June 1920, and Prime Minister and Minister of Security from 9 December 1919 to 11 June 1920.

body.zh-Hant: 1920年6月12日至1921年6月18日，烏爾馬尼斯再度出任總理。他在1919年9月、1920年4月11日及1921年4月27日分別遇到暗殺未遂或遭襲。1925年9月24日至1926年5月6日他又擔任總理，1926年5月7日至12月18日改任外交部長。1931年3月27日至12月5日，以及1934年3月17日至5月15日，他同時擔任總理與外交部長。
body.en: From 12 June 1920 to 18 June 1921 Ulmanis was again Prime Minister. Attempts or assaults on him are recorded in September 1919, on 11 April 1920 and on 27 April 1921. He was Prime Minister again from 24 September 1925 to 6 May 1926, then Minister of Foreign Affairs from 7 May to 18 December 1926. Between 27 March and 5 December 1931, and between 17 March and 15 May 1934, he held both the premiership and the foreign ministry.

heading.en: The 1934 coup, authoritarian rule and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1934年5月15日，烏爾馬尼斯發動政變，拉脫維亞自此進入他的威權統治時期。他在1934年5月18日至1940年6月20日擔任總理。1940年7月21日，他把領導權交給基爾亨施泰因斯，7月22日被押往蘇聯。1941年7月4日蘇聯當局逮捕他。1942年9月20日，他死於克拉斯諾沃茨克的監獄。
body.en: On 15 May 1934 Ulmanis organized a coup, and his period of authoritarian power in Latvia began. He was Prime Minister from 18 May 1934 to 20 June 1940. On 21 July 1940 he passed the leader’s power to A. Kirhenšteins, and on 22 July he was deported to the USSR. Soviet power arrested him on 4 July 1941. He died in the Krasnovodsk prison on 20 September 1942.

body.zh-Hant: 費薩爾二世1935年5月2日生於巴格達。他是費薩爾一世的孫子，也是前漢志國王胡笙·伊本·阿里的曾孫。1939年，他的父親加齊死於車禍時，他被宣布為國王。當時他只有四歲，所以直到1953年才開始親自掌理國政，在此之前由叔父擔任攝政。
body.en: Faisal II was born in Baghdad on 2 May 1935. He was a grandson of Faisal I and a great-grandson of Hussein ibn Ali, the former king of the Hijaz. He was proclaimed king in 1939 when his father Ghazi died in a car accident. As he was only four years old at the time, he took over the government himself only in 1953, after his uncle had served as regent.

tidligere konge over Hijaz

overtok han styret først i 1953 etter at onkelen hadde fungert som regent

body.zh-Hant: 第二次世界大戰期間，他隨母親被疏散到英國，並在倫敦上學。1951年，他出版了一本阿拉伯文的柔道與自衛書籍，並分發給其他阿拉伯王室成員。
body.en: During the Second World War he was evacuated to Britain with his mother and attended school in London. In 1951 he published a book in Arabic on judo and self-defence, which he distributed to other Arab royals.

fikk skolegang i London
Feisal 2. utga i 1951 en bok på arabisk om judo og selvforsvar
som han distribuerte til andre arabiske kongelige

heading.zh-Hant: 親政、親英政策與1958年政變
heading.en: Personal rule, pro-British policy and the 1958 coup

body.zh-Hant: 費薩爾是在動盪的轉型期登基的年輕而缺乏經驗的國王。他與叔父王儲阿卜杜勒·伊拉赫及首相努里·薩義德合作，推行親英政策。為了安撫阿拉伯民族主義者，他成為約旦與伊拉克聯盟的元首。1958年7月14日，卡西姆將軍發動政變廢除君主制，使伊拉克成為共和國；費薩爾二世與數名家族成員被處決。
body.en: Faisal was a young and inexperienced king in an unstable period of change. He pursued a pro-British policy together with his uncle, Crown Prince Abd al-Ilah, and Prime Minister Nuri al-Said. To placate Arab nationalists he became head of state of an alliance between Jordan and Iraq. On 14 July 1958 General Abd al-Karim Qasim led a coup that dissolved the monarchy and made Iraq a republic; Faisal II was executed together with several family members.
